response.sql: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rental_price_per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating) SELECT rating, avg_replacement_cost, avg_rental_price_per_day, avg_rental_price_per_day / AVG(avg_rental_price_per_day) OVER () AS ratio_to_rating_average FROM rating_averages ORDER BY rating

assumptions.assumption: Each film’s rental price per day is its rental_rate divided by its stated rental_duration; ratings are weighted equally in the comparison average.
